materials.blooms: few restrained cream or plum living accents
materials.leaves: deep and muted natural greens on curved leaves with visible thickness and vein structure
materials.living_wood: layered, branching rootwood with tapered growth and visible joins
materials.seed_pods: warm natural ochre, small but visible at gameplay distance

prohibited_changes: do not change RoomDefinition landmarks, site dimensions, work-site identity, growth stages or assignments
do not add visual geometry to collision, navigation, selection, pathfinding or work calculations
do not add canonical-room-specific placement or simulation logic
do not use Clockwork gears, industrial roofs, metal cladding or simple green recoloring
do not use flat leaf cards, smooth sphere crowns or a closed roof that hides the work area
required_features: a recognizable asymmetrical trunk and branching nursery canopy
curved, tapered leaves with visible thickness rather than broad flat cards
an open, readable ground-level work area that preserves the actual module's work surface and entrance
large separated seed pods that remain visible at the 64-inch settlement camera
a Verdant silhouette distinct from the generic Scavenger canopy and Clockwork roof forms
fit the existing 26 x 10 x 18 inch presentation envelope
stylization_rationale: RoomScale is a miniature diorama. Stylization may clarify the cultivated-tree silhouette, but the nursery must remain physically assembled, organically varied, faction-distinct and readable at normal settlement distance.
visual_target: A believable miniature living-architecture nursery centered on an asymmetrical branching trunk and a distinctive mature canopy. At the 64-inch Room A settlement camera, the nursery should read as a cultivated tree-workshop rather than a green roof or generic shelter. Keep an open, usable ground-level work area, visible root supports and several large seed pods. Build the foliage from curved, tapered, visibly thick individual leaves; avoid flat cards and sphere crowns. Use deep natural greens, warm living wood and restrained seed-ochre or bloom accents. Preserve the existing 26 x 10 x 18 inch presentation site and all simulation-owned growth and work behavior.
